action.old_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # --- input validation ---
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                     (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                     (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if arr.shape != logp_with_result.shape:
            raise ValueError("All log-probability arrays must have the same shape")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isreal(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # --- compute normalized weights (T01) ---
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=np.float64)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_weights = raw_weights.sum()
    if sum_weights == 0:
        # edge case: all weights zero (future_horizon > 5), fallback to uniform
        norm_weights = np.full_like(raw_weights, 1.0 / future_horizon)
    else:
        norm_weights = raw_weights / sum_weights

    # --- weighted future-token loss (T02) ---
    L_plus = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(norm_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # --- stronger counterfactual baseline (T03) ---
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    # --- margin and threshold (T04) ---
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
